evidence: Reproducible local conformance test over TLS with a disposable test certificate
verified: Discover a Python-issued card over HTTPS
Resolve the same contact ID to a new primary through a saved backup after stopping the old host
Verify the same signed alias history at the new primary
Keep the current pin when a replica is stale
Reject conflicting signatures, expiry, skipped revisions, substitute roots and malformed documents

checks.requires: Build dist first, then use local Playwright with the Chrome channel and disposable loopback origins.
exercises: Two independent contacts lose their original primary domains and restore their encrypted books offline on a fresh app origin.
One uses a signed backup. The other checks a public HTML lead against the saved identity.
Browser and CLI emit identical public HTML and display the full contact ID as ordinary text.
Concurrent browser tabs serialize updates. Evicted public shell files retain their integrity checks.
